name: Map Maker: Enemies
note: Catalog of every enemy unit of the game (generated by tools/make_map_maker_helper.py from the game data). Fly +v: the units are in rows with the name written on the floor in front of each, the bosses in the last rows. They wait asleep and only wake up when they take damage (script spawns, no group; values.maxEnemies lifts the usual limit of 140 living enemies). /room N jumps to a group of rows. Nothing ends this map: leave with /leave.

signs.key: ENEMIES: 784 units, asleep until they are hit
BOSSES: 38 boss units, asleep until they are hit

script.note: Every enemy is a spawn of its own, asleep, no wake radius and no group: it only wakes up when it takes damage (and nothing else wakes with it).
